title: RECAST: A Machine-Learning Framework for Correction and Super-Resolution of Coarse-Grid PDE Solvers
abstract: arXiv:2608.11572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coarse-grid numerical solvers can substantially reduce the computational cost of time-dependent PDE simulation, but under-resolution often degrades both the trajectory and the spatial fidelity of the solution. We introduce RECAST (Recurrent Error Correction And Super-resolution of coarse-grid Trajectories), a machine-learning framework designed to restore this lost accuracy while retaining coarse-grid evolution. RECAST combines learned correction within the numerical time-stepping loop with reconstruction of the corresponding fine-grid state from the corrected coarse history. We evaluate the framework on six one-dimensional PDE systems spanning transport, diffusion, dispersion, reaction, and wave dynamics, using spatial grids coarsened by factors of 8-16 and 1000-step closed-loop rollouts from unseen initial conditions. translated_title: RECAST：一种用于粗网格PDE求解器校正与超分辨率的机器学习框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11572v1 公告类型：新 摘要：粗网格数值求解器可以大幅降低时间相关偏微分方程模拟的计算成本，但分辨率不足常常会降低解的轨迹和空间保真度。我们引入了RECAST（粗网格轨迹的递归误差校正与超分辨率），这是一种机器学习框架，旨在恢复这种丢失的精度，同时保持粗网格演化。RECAST将数值时间步进循环中的学习校正与从校正后的粗历史中重建相应细网格状态相结合。我们在六个一维PDE系统上评估了该框架，涵盖传输、扩散、色散、反应和波动动力学，使用空间网格粗化因子为8-16，并从未见过的初始条件进行1000步闭环滚动。在所有测试案例中，RECAST与细网格参考解保持紧密一致，并减少了时间平均误差。
tldr: 该论文提出RECAST框架，通过结合数值时间步进中的学习校正和细网格状态重建，在粗网格求解器中恢复精度，并在多个一维PDE系统上显著提升模拟保真度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RECAST, a machine-learning framework that combines learned correction within numerical time-stepping and fine-grid state reconstruction to restore accuracy in coarse-grid PDE solvers, achieving significant fidelity improvements across multiple 1D PDE systems.
